test_negative_red_green_structural_novelty_is_rejected_both_ways[def _classify_indent(text: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Return one of '2space', '4space', 'tab', or None when no leading
    indent on any line. We bias toward the ratio of indented lines so a single
    tab in a Python file doesn't outvote a thousand 4-space lines."""
    import statistics
    counts = Counter()
    widths = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        widths += 1
    if statistics and widths:
        counts["2space"] += 1
    return counts.most_common(1)[0][0] if counts else None
]

source_snapshot_note: Hashes collected after runs in an existing dirty working tree. Later narrow regression runs are identified separately; this is not proof of whole-tree immutability or attribution of all edits.
limitations: Provider responses scripted at SDK/adapter boundary; no paid/live model calls or customer latency measurement.
Real local routing, gates, filesystem, subprocess validation and workflow entrypoints; external DB/embeddings disabled.
CLI now uses actual DB-disabled startup, without a persistence adapter.
Five original revision cases intentionally retain a real 30-second preflight timeout; total suite time is not an end-user SLA.
Small Python fixtures and bounded indentation behavior matrix; no claim of general codebase correctness.
Supplementary runs overlap the integration suite and each other; do not sum their case counts as unique coverage.
Historical September 9 findings on CRLF, backups, legacy self-correction, HTTP history, concurrency and child processes remain outside this remediation scope.
No operating-system sandbox, enterprise-security certification, live model benchmark or durable autonomous Dream guarantee was established.
